intent.zh: 确认端到端流程文件化并与合规/客户标准对齐
intent.en: Ensure end-to-end processes are documented and aligned with compliance and customer standards.

questions.id: process-是否有端到端-npi-流程-需求-架构-设计-验证-移交-并落实职责分工

text.zh: 是否有端到端 NPI 流程（需求→架构→设计→验证→移交），并落实职责分工？
text.en: Do we run an end-to-end NPI process (requirements → architecture → design → verification → handover) with clear role ownership?

zh.1: 无端到端 NPI 流程，节点靠经验推进。
zh.2: 有流程框架但未纳入标准里程碑与角色责任。
zh.3: 端到端 NPI 流程已文档化，关键里程碑与交付物有规定。
zh.4: 流程结合跨部门评审与门禁，执行状态有记录与复盘。
zh.5: 流程与项目管理系统集成，指标与风险自动监控。

en.1: No end-to-end NPI process; phases advance based on personal experience.
en.2: Process framework exists but lacks standard milestones and role accountability.
en.3: End-to-end NPI process is documented with specified milestones and deliverables.
en.4: Process ties into cross-functional reviews and gates with execution tracked and retroed.
en.5: Process integrates with the project management system with automatic metric and risk monitoring.

focus: 组织架构与岗位说明书是否发布
跨团队接口人和升级路径是否明确
职责边界与权限如何维护
端到端流程阶段与交付物
ask: 组织架构多长时间更新一次？
跨团队升级路径和 SLA 如何定义？
NPI 流程的关键 Gate 是哪些？
Entry/Exit 判定如何落地？
evidence: 最新组织架构图与岗位说明
阶段评审纪要与交付物清单
threshold: 组织职责发布并可查询
升级路径在项目中可验证
端到端流程文件化并执行
关键 Gate 结果可追溯

focus: Whether the org chart and job descriptions are published
Whether cross-team interface owners and escalation paths are clear
How role boundaries and permissions are maintained
ask: How often is the org chart updated?
How are cross-team escalation paths and SLAs defined?
What are the key gates in the NPI process?
How are Entry/Exit criteria enforced?
evidence: Latest org chart and job descriptions
Phase review minutes and deliverable checklists
threshold: Role responsibilities are published and discoverable
Escalation paths can be validated in projects
End-to-end process is documented and executed
Key gate outcomes are traceable

questions.id: process-是否建立研发设计规范库-pcb-esd-射频-结构等-并保持版本可追溯

text.zh: 是否建立研发设计规范库（PCB、ESD、射频、结构等）并保持版本可追溯？
text.en: Do we maintain a controlled design standards library (PCB, ESD, RF, mechanical, etc.) with version traceability?

zh.1: 无统一设计规范，依赖个人经验。
zh.2: 有零散规范或旧版本，缺更新机制。
zh.3: 关键领域建立受控的设计规范并发布。
zh.4: 规范定期评审并关联培训/检查表，执行有记录。
zh.5: 规范与工具链/DRC 联动，变更自动通知并追踪执行。

en.1: No unified design standards; work relies on individual experience.
en.2: Scattered or outdated standards with no refresh mechanism.
en.3: Controlled standards exist and are published for critical domains.
en.4: Standards are reviewed periodically with linked training/checklists and execution records.
en.5: Standards integrate with toolchains/DRC so changes auto-notify and execution is tracked.

focus: 接口目标 ESD/Surge 等级
跌落/扭转/点载 CAE 与实测闭环
密封公差链与透气策略
样机/批次与版本对应关系
ask: 目标 ESD/Surge 等级是多少？
关键接口的 TVS BOM 与布局如何验证？
是否进行带电插拔/EFT/Latch-up 预验证？
CAE 如何与实测比对？
密封公差链如何计算？
仿真与 OTA 数据如何对齐？
多姿态 OTA 结果是否满足？
如何快速定位受影响样机？
数据是否实时更新？
规范如何归档与受控？
版本更新如何通知到项目？
evidence: 接口布局截图与器件曲线
跌落/扭转/密封测试数据
threshold: 接触放电≥8kV，空气放电≥15kV
异常失效注入通过且无复位
1.5m 六面多次功能正常
IP 目标与耐蚀要求达成
关键频段余量满足预算并留裕量
样机与版本双向追溯可在系统中完成
关键设计规范受控且及时更新

focus: Sealing tolerance stack and venting strategy
ask: What target ESD/Surge level do we design for?
How do we validate TVS BOM and layout for critical interfaces?
Do we run hot-plug/EFT/latch-up pre-validation?
How do CAE results compare with physical testing?
How is the sealing tolerance stack calculated?
How do simulations align with OTA data?
Do multi-posture OTA results meet targets?
How do we quickly identify affected prototypes?
Is the traceability data updated in real time?
How are standards archived and controlled?

evidence: Interface layout snapshots and device curves
threshold: Contact discharge ≥8 kV, air discharge ≥15 kV
Fault injection passes without resets
1.5 m six-face drops maintain function
Ingress protection and corrosion targets achieved
Key frequency margins meet the budget with headroom

Critical design standards are controlled and refreshed promptly

questions.id: process-对外部输入-客户-法规-pcn-是否建立变更感知与落地机制

text.zh: 对外部输入（客户/法规/PCN）是否建立变更感知与落地机制？
text.en: Do we maintain a mechanism to sense and implement external inputs (customer, regulatory, PCN)?

zh.1: 无外部输入跟踪机制，信息靠个人传达。
zh.2: 能接收外部输入但缺评估与落实记录。
zh.3: 建立外部输入台账并指定责任人跟进落实。
zh.4: 变更评估流程覆盖影响分析与验证计划，闭环可审计。
zh.5: 外部输入与需求/配置系统联动，落地状态可视化与预警。

en.1: No mechanism to track external inputs; information relies on individuals.
en.2: External inputs are received but assessments and execution are undocumented.
en.3: External input register exists with assigned owners driving closure.
en.4: Change assessment covers impact analysis and validation plans with auditable closure.
en.5: External inputs link to requirements/config systems with visible status and alerts.

focus: 客户/法规输入感知机制
ask: 影响评估包含哪些输入？
ECN 实施状态如何追踪？
通知流程如何触发？
如何确认对方已收到并执行？
外部输入如何捕获并派发？
影响评估包含哪些维度？
threshold: 所有变更均完成影响评估与验证闭环
关键通知留痕并可审计
关键外部输入均评估并形成验证计划

ask: What inputs are covered in the impact assessment?
How is ECN implementation status tracked?
How is the notification process triggered?
How do you confirm recipients received and acted?
How are external inputs captured and dispatched?
Which dimensions are evaluated in the impact assessment?
threshold: Every change completes impact assessment and validation closure
Critical notifications are logged and auditable
All critical external inputs are assessed with validation plans
